items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: We had a five-piece band... Charlie(?) leaves four... It must have been Charlie Shavers.

ctx.x: We had a five-piece band, yeah. Let's see now, was it five? We had a banjo, piano, Chuck, myself (three), Charlie(?) leaves four, and something else has to leave five... Did I say banjo?

items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think there's one of "China Boy" or something... [INTERVIEWEE] It must have been Charlie Shavers.

ctx.x: Not with me... Oh yeah! I don't think I got into that. Did you hear me playing on that?
I think there's one of "China Boy" or something...
It must have been Charlie Shavers.
